title: Inactivate a Position
goal: Set a position to Inactive in Oracle from the right effective date, with the reason recorded.
context: Screen steps are taken from the HCM job aid 'Inactivate Position in Oracle Cloud' (last updated 7/21/25). DRAFT FOR SME REVIEW: the 'check the position is vacant' checkpoint, the hints and the follow-up reminder describe sensible practice but are not from a published SOP. Confirm them and the contacts with the HCM Academy team.

steps.title: Check the position can be inactivated
steps.instruction: Before you start, make sure you have the position number and that nobody is currently in the position.
steps.why: Inactivating a position that still has someone in it causes problems for that person's record. If you are not sure, ask before you go on.
steps.confirm: I have the position number and it is vacant

steps.title: Open Our Workforce
steps.instruction: From the Oracle Home page, select the Our Workforce tab.
steps.where: The row of tabs near the top of the Home page.
steps.expect: The Our Workforce apps and quick actions show.

steps.title: Open Workforce Structures
steps.where: In the apps on the Our Workforce tab.
steps.expect: The Workforce Structures page opens with a list of tasks.

steps.title: Open Manage Positions
steps.where: In the list of tasks on the Workforce Structures page.
steps.expect: The Manage Positions search page opens.

steps.title: Search for the position
steps.instruction: Enter the Business Unit, the Code (this is the position number) and the Effective As-of Date. Then select Search.
steps.where: The search fields at the top of Manage Positions.
steps.expect: The position appears in the results.
hints: If nothing comes back, check the Effective As-of Date. A date before the position existed returns no results.

steps.title: Open the position
hints: Check the position code on the page matches the number you were given before you change anything.

steps.title: Choose Update
steps.instruction: Open the Edit drop-down and choose Update.
steps.where: The Edit drop-down on the position page.
steps.expect: The position opens for editing and asks for an effective date and action reason.

steps.title: Confirm the effective date
steps.instruction: Confirm the effective date is correct. Change it if it is not.
steps.expect: The date shown is the date the position should become inactive.
steps.why: The position stays active up to this date and is inactive from it.

steps.title: Set the action reason
steps.instruction: In the Action Reason drop-down, choose Inactivate Position. Then confirm the field shows Inactivate Position.
steps.why: The action reason is what tells reporting and audit what kind of change this was.

steps.title: Set the status to Inactive
steps.instruction: In the Status drop-down, choose Inactive.

steps.title: Review
steps.where: At the top of the page.
steps.expect: The review page opens and shows the position as Inactive.

steps.title: Confirm it shows Inactive
steps.instruction: On the review page, confirm the position has been updated to Inactive.
steps.why: This is the last look before the change is submitted.

steps.title: Explain the reason
steps.instruction: In the Comments section, explain the reason for the update.
steps.where: The Comments section on the review page.
steps.expect: Your comment shows in the Comments section.
hints: One plain sentence is enough: why the position is being inactivated and who asked for it.

steps.title: Submit
steps.instruction: Select Submit, then confirm the submission.
steps.where: At the top of the screen.
steps.expect: Oracle confirms the change was submitted.

callouts.say: The Code field is the position number.
callouts.source: Inactivate Position in Oracle Cloud, job aid updated 7/21/25

callouts.say: Both fields must be set: Action Reason to Inactivate Position, and Status to Inactive.
callouts.source: Inactivate Position in Oracle Cloud, job aid updated 7/21/25

reminders.say: Search for the position again and check it shows as Inactive from the effective date.

recap.summary: You set a position to Inactive from the right effective date, with the action reason and a comment recorded.
nextSteps: Check the position shows as Inactive in Manage Positions.
